$description: RAG palette set 'console-supercharge' (s157-D2, the named-palette tier; extends ADR-0014's neutral DNA tier mechanism). ✅ NAME RATIFIED AS-IS by s160-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-12) — was: '⚠ FILE NAME IS A PLACEHOLDER — palette NAMES are Dave's to rule'; the #158 'may split later' float is CLOSED. Consumed by: apollo-console + apollo-supercharge (declared in tokens/themes/_themes.json as ragPalette). Scope: the twelve CORE rag hue keys. -tint keys are DELIBERATELY ABSENT — they derive from per-theme grounds (s123-D3) and stay per-theme. Verified by knowledge/_validate_palette_tier.py.
$provenance: s122-D3 (one shared map, fence lifted s122-D4) + s132-D1 (information re-hue). SOURCED from tokens/themes/apollo-console.overrides.json overrides/rag/* and ASSERTED hex-identical against apollo-supercharge.overrides.json at extraction time.

$partialKeys.$note: Keys in the palette VOCABULARY that this set does not declare. Declared here so the fall-through is VISIBLE rather than silent (the #157 catch: no theme overrides rag/*-ink, so non-mono themes fall through to mono's values). ⛔ NOT A RULING — no green/red fork for non-mono -ink rungs is governed; s151-D1/s155-D1 scope those rungs MONO ONLY. Dave rules any change. #168 (option 82-B): the four rag/*-graphic rungs are the GRAPHIC-STRENGTH tier (R-D3's amber/graphic shape generalised to all four hues) and are declared ABSENT here — this palette has NO retired graphic-strength values recorded in provenance, and inventing them is forbidden. CONSEQUENCE: a chart series in this theme falls through to the mono values. ⛔ FLAGGED FOR DAVE — an ABSENT rung is a declared hole, not a ruling.
